Codex review: needs real behavior proof before merge. ## What this changes Route workspace-only CLI turns through scoped OpenClaw MCP tools and reject backends that cannot enforce that restriction. **Example:** An agent rooted at /workspace/main has tools.fs.workspaceOnly enabled and requests /workspace/other/note.txt. - **Before:** Native CLI file tools can admit the outside-workspace operation. - **After:** Native file tools are disabled and the scoped OpenClaw file tool rejects the path. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🧂 unranked krab **(1/6)** | The repair is focused and the prior question-capability defect is fixed, but authority proof and existing-setting upgrade evidence remain incomplete. | | **Proof confidence** | 🧂 unranked krab **(1/6)** | Real behavior proof is necessary before merge. See [Before merge](#before-merge). | | **Patch quality** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | Security review found an item that needs attention. | ## Product **Kind:** Bug fix · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** CLI-backed agents can access files outside their workspace despite an enabled workspace-only restriction. **Reason:** The documented restriction has concrete user value, and the maintainer-authored direction selects existing filesystem enforcement with explicit backend requirements. ## Merge readiness ⛔ **Blocked before merge - 5 items remain** Keep this PR open: it addresses a current filesystem-policy gap, preserves question capability after the correction, and retains one actionable recovery-message defect. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `93b6f473c00df485dfafbddf22a9f2bf1cb642ce` ## Before merge - [ ] **Add real behavior proof** - Authority-chain proof required: supplied tests run real OpenClaw filesystem tools behind a substituted backend and grant lifecycle, rather than a real CLI client through MCP; provide redacted terminal output or logs showing allowed workspace operations, outside and distinct-agent workspace rejection, and revoked or replaced grants rejected before I/O, removing credentials, IPs, and non-public endpoints. After adding proof, update the PR body, then request a new review with `@clawsweeper re-review`. The PR author or someone with repository write access can request it. - [ ] **Explain recovery when workspace-only execution is refused (P3)** - When workspaceOnly is enabled on a backend without bundled MCP or exact selection, or on a node-hosted session, preparation now stops with only “cannot enforce workspace-only tool policy.” The user cannot tell which requirement failed or how to resume safely. Preserve the refusal, identify the unsupported requirement, and name a supported recovery such as selecting a backend with bundled MCP and exact tool selection. This prior P3 finding remains unresolved. - [ ] **Resolve security concern: Verify workspace identity and grant retirement** - The mediation path carries an execution workspace alongside a potentially different policy identity and can transfer authority onto a reusable CLI process bearer; supplied tests substitute the grant lifecycle and cannot establish isolation or revocation at the final filesystem effect. - [ ] **Resolve merge risk** - Workspace isolation now depends on MCP grant scoping and current authority across CLI process reuse, including runs whose execution and policy agents differ. - [ ] **Add data-model compatibility proof** - The review found that existing stored data may not work after upgrade. Show that existing data still loads and works with this change. ## Findings - [P3] Explain recovery when workspace-only execution is refused — `src/agents/cli-runner/prepare-tool-policy.ts:105-106` - [medium] Verify workspace identity and grant retirement — `src/agents/cli-runner/prepare.ts:318` ### Tests - Missing end-to-end proof: Supply real-client MCP filesystem results, nearest-forbidden workspace and revoked-grant rejection before I/O, and a latest-stable upgrade run preserving existing settings and session data.
Agent review details ### How this fits together CLI preparation converts configured tool restrictions into backend tool selections and run-bound MCP grants; the Gateway resolves those grants into policy-filtered tools that perform filesystem operations. ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Agent configuration] --> B[CLI preparation] B --> C[Exact tool selection] B --> D[Run-bound MCP grant] C --> E[CLI backend] E --> D D --> F[Scoped OpenClaw tools] F --> G[Workspace filesystem] ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Keep filesystem enforcement with the existing scoped tool owners and make unsupported-backend refusals actionable. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Current-main source permits ordinary native CLI file admission without applying workspaceOnly; the linked report supplies affected releases and outside-workspace read steps, but no live reproduction was run during this review. Is this the best way to solve the issue? Reusing scoped OpenClaw tools is a focused repair that avoids duplicating containment logic in native permission handlers. Full review comments: - [P3] Explain recovery when workspace-only execution is refused — `src/agents/cli-runner/prepare-tool-policy.ts:105-106` When workspaceOnly is enabled on a backend without bundled MCP or exact selection, or on a node-hosted session, preparation now stops with only “cannot enforce workspace-only tool policy.” The user cannot tell which requirement failed or how to resume safely. Preserve the refusal, identify the unsupported requirement, and name a supported recovery such as selecting a backend with bundled MCP and exact tool selection. This prior P3 finding remains unresolved. Confidence: 0.98 Overall correctness: patch is correct Overall confidence: 0.9 AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [9828bcfff7e9](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9828bcfff7e9aae0a49c523b658df57282dcb4e8). ### Merge-risk options **Maintainer options:** 1. **Validate the existing grant boundary (recommended)** Demonstrate that the mediated execution workspace remains authoritative across differing agent identities and CLI process reuse, with retired grants rejected before filesystem I/O. ### Provenance checked - `CLI completion and restricted-turn mediation` keeps the original intent (72f5840c11922793dfacad33c9fc1c0bd3e8b175: Restore policy-filtered completion tools through MCP because native CLI tools cannot enforce captured restrictions.) - `Sender and delegated execution restrictions` keeps the original intent (5e0066bbf9213366406f1a081868f29a530b5af4: Keep inherited restrictions and explicit delegated authority enforced during CLI execution.) - `Anthropic native capability projection` keeps the original intent (82d2c992a25bc38336e1a5d49e1ef15d03798f19: Translate equivalent observed native capabilities into canonical authority for scheduled work.) ### Testing Proof path: in-process harness. ### Security Needs attention: No concrete introduced bypass was established, but the changed grant boundary still needs final-effect authority evidence. ### Evidence Security concerns: - [medium] Verify workspace identity and grant retirement — `src/agents/cli-runner/prepare.ts:318` The mediation path carries an execution workspace alongside a potentially different policy identity and can transfer authority onto a reusable CLI process bearer; supplied tests substitute the grant lifecycle and cannot establish isolation or revocation at the final filesystem effect. Confidence: 0.95 What I checked: - **Introduced change:** The pinned introduction diff adds workspace-only mediation, exact native-capability projection, backend requirements, and regression coverage; endpoint drift was excluded. ([`src/agents/cli-runner/prepare-tool-policy.ts:90`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/93b6f473c00df485dfafbddf22a9f2bf1cb642ce/src/agents/cli-runner/prepare-tool-policy.ts#L90), [93b6f473c00d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/93b6f473c00df485dfafbddf22a9f2bf1cb642ce)) - **Current main still needs the repair:** Fetched main mediates completion, sender-restricted, and delegated turns but has no workspaceOnly condition in this policy owner. ([`src/agents/cli-runner/prepare-tool-policy.ts:85`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/9828bcfff7e9aae0a49c523b658df57282dcb4e8/src/agents/cli-runner/prepare-tool-policy.ts#L85), [9828bcfff7e9](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9828bcfff7e9aae0a49c523b658df57282dcb4e8)) - **Previous findings checked:** The correction maps AskUserQuestion to ask_user, addressing the prior P2 finding; the refusal message is unchanged and still supplies no recovery action. ([`extensions/anthropic/cli-backend.ts:63`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/93b6f473c00df485dfafbddf22a9f2bf1cb642ce/extensions/anthropic/cli-backend.ts#L63), [93b6f473c00d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/93b6f473c00df485dfafbddf22a9f2bf1cb642ce)) - **Proof boundary:** The added tests exercise real filesystem tools, but substitute the backend, grant minting, admission binding, and revocation; they do not exercise a real CLI-to-MCP request. ([`src/agents/cli-runner/prepare.completion-tools.test.ts:89`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/93b6f473c00df485dfafbddf22a9f2bf1cb642ce/src/agents/cli-runner/prepare.completion-tools.test.ts#L89), [93b6f473c00d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/93b6f473c00df485dfafbddf22a9f2bf1cb642ce)) - **Existing authority owners:** CLI grants carry the execution workspace and optional runtime-policy identity; MCP checks current grant authority and passes that check into tool resolution. ([`src/gateway/mcp-http.ts:310`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/93b6f473c00df485dfafbddf22a9f2bf1cb642ce/src/gateway/mcp-http.ts#L310), [93b6f473c00d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/93b6f473c00df485dfafbddf22a9f2bf1cb642ce)) - **Accepted backend requirement:** The maintainer-authored body explicitly requires bundled MCP and exact tool selection, accepting refusal of unsupported workspace-only turns; the documentation records that requirement at https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cli-backends. ([`docs/gateway/cli-backends.md:129`](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cli-backends), [93b6f473c00d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/93b6f473c00df485dfafbddf22a9f2bf1cb642ce)) Likely related people: - **Peter Steinberger:** Raw commit 82d2c992a25bc38336e1a5d49e1ef15d03798f19 adds extensions/anthropic/cli-backend.ts:63 relative to its recorded parents. This identifies author metadata, not feature responsibility or a PR merger. (role: source-line author; confidence: high; commits: [82d2c992a25b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/82d2c992a25bc38336e1a5d49e1ef15d03798f19); files: `extensions/anthropic/cli-backend.ts`) - **Stronggenetics:** Raw commit 72f5840c11922793dfacad33c9fc1c0bd3e8b175 adds src/agents/cli-runner/prepare-tool-policy.ts:68 relative to its recorded parents. This identifies author metadata, not feature responsibility or a PR merger. (role: source-line author; confidence: medium; commits: [72f5840c1192](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/72f5840c11922793dfacad33c9fc1c0bd3e8b175); files: `src/agents/cli-runner/prepare-tool-policy.ts`) ### PR surface Source +22, Tests +208, Docs +5. Total +235 across 7 files. Added test files: 0.
View PR surface stats | Area | Files | Added | Removed | Net | |---|---:|---:|---:|---:| | Source | 3 | 29 | 7 | +22 | | Tests | 3 | 208 | 0 | +208 | | Docs | 1 | 5 | 0 | +5 | | Config | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | | Generated | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | | Other | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | | **Total** | **7** | **242** | **7** | **+235** |
### Labels Label changes: No label changes. Label justifications: - `P2`: This restores a configured filesystem restriction on CLI-backed turns without evidence of a broader runtime outage. - `merge-risk: 🚨 compatibility`: Existing workspace-only configurations on unsupported or node-hosted backends now refuse execution; the maintainer-authored direction explicitly accepts this restriction. - `merge-risk: 🚨 security-boundary`: File operations move from native CLI execution to run-bound MCP authority, making workspace identity and grant retirement security-relevant. - `rating: 🧂 unranked krab`: Overall readiness is 🧂 unranked krab; proof is 🧂 unranked krab and patch quality is 🦐 gold shrimp. - `status: 📣 needs proof`: The PR needs real behavior proof before ClawSweeper can clear the contributor ask. ### Rank-up moves Optional improvements that raise the rating; they are not merge blockers. - Add final-effect proof through a real CLI client for the nearest unauthorized workspace and verify revocation invalidates the grant before I/O. ### Rating scale 6/6 🦀 challenger crab · 5/6 🦞 diamond lobster · 4/6 🐚 platinum hermit · 3/6 🦐 gold shrimp · 2/6 🦪 silver shellfish · 1/6 🧂 unranked krab. Overall follows the weaker of proof and patch quality; ✨ marks media proof (a screenshot, video, or linked artifact) that directly shows the changed behavior. ### Workflow ClawSweeper edits this one comment on every review. Comment `@clawsweeper re-review` for a fresh review only. Repair and merge execution lanes are retired. ### History
Review history (1 earlier review cycle) - reviewed 2026-10-16T22:24:35.280Z sha 83e60fa702168dd4bfb194c8949e9f26515a9bc5 :: needs real behavior proof before merge. :: [P2] Preserve exact non-file native capabilities | [P3] Explain recovery when workspace-only execution is refused
